title: Financial Instruments: Disclosure and Presentation
summary: Withdrawn standard. IPSAS 15 Financial Instruments: Disclosure and Presentation was withdrawn for periods beginning 1 January 2013 and superseded by IPSAS 28, IPSAS 29 and IPSAS 30, most of whose content now resides in IPSAS 41.
description: IPSAS 15 Financial Instruments: Disclosure and Presentation was withdrawn; superseded by IPSAS 28, IPSAS 29 and IPSAS 30 (largely absorbed into IPSAS 41). Retained as a numbering placeholder with a redirect map.
